changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'TagType') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[TagType]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [Value] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_createdOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_createdBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_updatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_updatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_TagType_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_TagType] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END

changeSet.sql: if not exists (select 1 from TagType where Value = 'General' and id = 1) begin SET IDENTITY_INSERT TagType on insert into [TagType] (id, Value, Uid, CreatedOn, UpdatedOn, CreatedBy, UpdatedBy) values (1, 'General', '00000001-0000-0000-0000-b00000000011', getutcdate(), getutcdate(), 0, 0) SET IDENTITY_INSERT TagType off end
